purpose: Add lawsuits, judgments, settlements, testimony, family actions, lawyers, intermediaries, whistleblowers, platform-harm evidence and death-investigation records to the Under-Culture system so the project can locate mechanisms of harm, protection, accountability and repair without treating accusations as findings.
central_question: When visible scandal erupts, which legal, institutional, financial, informational and relational mechanisms reveal where the underlying problem actually sits?
core_rule: Model procedural posture and evidentiary status before moral interpretation. A complaint, dismissal, settlement, verdict, conviction, coroner finding, bankruptcy plan and official inquiry are different evidence objects.

death_evidence_protocol.rule: Never encode CAUSED_DEATH or CAUSED_SUICIDE from temporal association, a family allegation, media phrasing, a forum archive or a platform ban.

levels.label: mere-association
levels.meaning: Person was discussed, harassed, targeted or active on a platform before death. No causal inference.

levels.label: self-or-family-attribution
levels.meaning: Deceased before death, family, or survivor publicly attributes a contribution. Preserve attribution only.

levels.label: civil-allegation
levels.meaning: A complaint alleges contribution or causal harm. Preserve as allegation until adjudicated.

levels.label: official-investigative-concern
levels.meaning: Coroner, regulator, platform, law enforcement or inquiry identifies a safety concern without a final causal finding.

levels.label: official-causal-contribution
levels.meaning: A competent coroner, court or medical authority finds a contribution within the scope of its proceeding.

levels.label: adjudicated-legal-causation
levels.meaning: A final legal ruling expressly establishes causal liability.

death_evidence_protocol.privacy_rule: Do not build lists of deaths as rhetorical ammunition. Record only cases that illuminate a mechanism and preserve dignity, uncertainty and counterevidence.

legal_mechanism_families.diagnostic_value: Shows how an information problem can become a human-security and economic problem without requiring a hidden organization.

anchors: Donnell Russell / R. Kelly victim and mother
legal_mechanism_families.diagnostic_value: Separates mere reputation management from criminally adjudicated intimidation.
Makes legal intermediaries and purchased investigative capacity visible instead of treating a scandal as only principal-versus-accuser.
Tracks when lawful confidentiality becomes an accountability bottleneck and when law or settlement reopens speech channels.

anchors: Epstein 2006-2008 resolution / In re Courtney Wild
legal_mechanism_families.diagnostic_value: Locates failures at the interface between prosecutorial discretion, secrecy, victim participation and available remedies.

anchors: JPMorgan, Deutsche Bank and Bank of America Epstein-related survivor settlements
legal_mechanism_families.diagnostic_value: Asks what duties and warning signals attach to enabling institutions while keeping settlement separate from guilt.
Shows how catastrophic outcomes can arise from delay, fragmentation or negligence without evidence of a coordinated cover-up.
Distinguishes third-party speech, product design, promises, algorithms, age safeguards and legal immunity.
Maps how hosting, CDN, registrar and payment infrastructure can become governance choke points without treating provider action as a court verdict.

anchors: Peter Thiel funding of Bollea litigation / Gawker
legal_mechanism_families.diagnostic_value: Reveals how capital can finance legal pressure while preserving that litigation funding is lawful and claims can be meritorious.
Shows how bankruptcy can become a collective accountability and compensation mechanism, while also shifting victims into administrative processes.
Tests classification power in court and prevents watchdog labels from becoming untouchable or automatically false.

case_anchors.key_point: Official coroner evidence supports a more-than-minimal contribution from harmful online material in this specific death.
Misrepresentation claims based on a platform's own safety promise survived Section 230 while product-liability theories tied to third-party content did not.
Cloudflare terminated services after describing an immediate threat to human life; this is provider risk assessment, not a judicial causation finding.
The current 2026 action survived dismissal but is principally copyright litigation; the plaintiff has also been sanctioned in related procedural disputes, which is essential counterevidence.
A close associate pleaded guilty to stalking a victim and her mother while pressuring withdrawal from civil litigation.
Official review documented serious FBI failures; DOJ later paid $138.7 million to settle 139 administrative claims.
DOJ found poor judgment and poor victim treatment while the en banc Eleventh Circuit limited the CVRA remedy outside a preexisting criminal case.
JPMorgan, Deutsche Bank and Bank of America reached large survivor class settlements; these are major accountability edges but not criminal findings.
Documented Black Cube engagement and later NDA-release/compensation processes expose both suppression and repair mechanisms.
A bankruptcy court record states it was undisputed that Thiel funded the Bollea litigation and permitted limited discovery into related financing questions.
Civil liability and a roughly $148 million jury award show how false public claims can translate into severe personal and financial consequences.
Fox settled for $787.5 million and acknowledged court rulings finding certain Dominion claims false.
Different ADL/SPLC cases produced different procedural outcomes, demonstrating why classifier disputes require case-specific legal status rather than blanket validation or dismissal.
Over 82,000 timely unique abuse claims were routed into a multibillion-dollar settlement-trust structure, with later disputes over claim-election mechanics.
The investigation and resulting reforms show how reporting rules, confidentiality rules and limitation periods can shape whether institutional abuse remains hidden.

lawyer_intermediary_model.rule: Do not treat lawyers as part of wrongdoing merely because they represent a controversial client. Record the exact service and whether a court, regulator, contract or reliable investigation documents conduct beyond ordinary representation.
lawyer_intermediary_model.escalation_rule: Only create a misconduct edge for a lawyer or firm when the conduct itself is sourced; representation alone creates REPRESENTS, not COMPLICIT_IN.

family_testimony_model.rule: Families can be witnesses, plaintiffs, campaigners, estate representatives and secondary victims. Preserve these roles separately.

investigatory_questions: Who first received a warning, complaint or report, and what did they do with it?
Which institution had the legal or practical power to stop continued exposure?
Did a lawyer, PR firm, investigator, insurer, bank, platform or donor materially change the information or accountability flow?
Were witnesses, accusers, employees or family members threatened, surveilled, sued, isolated, paid, released from NDAs or otherwise pressured?
Which claims were dismissed, which survived pleading, which reached discovery, and which were actually adjudicated?
What changed after exposure: compensation, policy, governance, regulation, criminal prosecution, bankruptcy, platform removal or nothing?
Where did accountability fail because of secrecy versus fragmentation, negligence, legal immunity, resource imbalance or genuine lack of evidence?
What counterevidence shows that an apparently suspicious relationship may instead be ordinary representation, lawful funding, incompetence or protected speech?

project_canon_mapping.Mud: legal and reputational residue accumulated through allegations, archives, filings, judgments and repeated retellings
project_canon_mapping.Farm: human beings or scandals converted into recurring attention and monetizable content
project_canon_mapping.Sektur: social territory in which claims, defenders, accusers, lawyers, commentators and archives repeatedly interact
project_canon_mapping.Swamp: institutional and incentive environment where accountability can be delayed, fragmented, purchased, obscured or repaired
project_canon_mapping.Door: the procedural threshold through which testimony becomes complaint, discovery, trial, judgment, settlement, appeal or reform
project_canon_mapping.Tree_of_Strife: root incentive -> mechanism -> intermediary -> observable act -> human consequence -> legal response -> reproducing or repaired condition
project_canon_mapping.Garden_or_tikkun: protection, truth-finding, compensation, restored speech, accountable procedure and reduced recurrence

safeguards: No person becomes a problem node merely because they are a relative, lawyer, donor, employee or contact.
Do not infer guilt from settlement, bankruptcy, document presence, client representation or funding alone.
Do not use suicides or deaths as counts against a community; use only source-bounded case records that illuminate a mechanism.
Model exoneration, dismissal, failed claims, sanctions and counterevidence with the same visibility as accusations.
Preserve survivor dignity and redact unnecessary identifying information.
A strong theory must predict observable records and survive attempts to falsify it.
